msg.sender becomes the transfer beneficiary in the onlyOwner withdraw function
block.timestamp is consumed by getCurrentYear, making the result miner/timestamp dependent
getCurrentYear calls timestamp2year on the current block timestamp
block.timestamp is passed as the argument to timestamp2year
mint performs totalSupply += 1 and artBalance[msg.sender] += 1
mint writes artBalance[msg.sender]
mint reads and writes totalSupply to derive new token ids
mint writes _ogs via _setOGs
mint writes _mintingYear via _setMintingYear
withdraw executes an external transfer to msg.sender
royaltyInfo computes _salePrice * royaltiesPercentage / 100
royaltyInfo reads the royaltiesPercentage constant
royaltyInfo returns the _royaltiesReceiver address
makeArt calls getCurrentYear when computing the artwork
tokenURI calls makeArt with the token's stored values
tokenURI reads _ogs[tokenId]
tokenURI reads _mintingYear[tokenId]
mint invokes _safeMint which reaches _checkOnERC721Received before totalSupply is updated
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient contract
